name: Mjölnir
description: Thor's legendary hammer, forged by dwarven craftsmen Sindri and Brokkr. Known for its incredible destructive power and the ability to return to Thor's hand after being thrown. The hammer is both a weapon against giants and a symbol of protection and blessing.
significance: Symbol of protection, consecration, and divine power. Used to bless marriages, births, and funerals. Represents the might of the Aesir against the forces of chaos.
properties: Always returns to Thor when thrown
Can only be wielded by those deemed worthy
Creates thunder and lightning when swung
Short handle due to Loki's interference during forging
